status: analysis protocol frozen before this replay; historical references already revealed
decision: Measurements required for each frozen liver-chip decision and differences between acquisition policies.
prediction_before_run: Known seven threshold-positive curves stop after their sealed first request. If remaining five curves stay ambiguous until completion, selected uses 25/46 hidden measurements and seven early reports. Comparator totals remain to be computed.
initial_context: Exactly the three sealed point IDs per drug and endpoint in choices.csv; endpoint-specific original dose grid.
threshold: Fixed 0.5 times response at INITIAL LOWEST CONCENTRATION, not minimum observed response. Preserve throughout replay. Equality counts as reduction.
calibration: Use original nine-drug q for each method and original epsilon; halfwidth=q*max(abs(initial lowest-dose response),epsilon). No new calibration or fitting.
predictor: Use pinned capacity_frozen_forecast module ND=NF=D=1 and original joblib estimators. Rebuild Task from measured rows ONLY, boolean keep of current length; query remaining concentration metadata ONLY. Recondition frozen predictor on k>=3 as in joint/run_joint.py. Preserve float32 inputs and original residual mixing. Training-selected ALBUMIN interpolation; VIABILITY adaptive10 alpha .25.
decision_order: If any measured value <= fixed threshold: report_reduction / observed_reduction.
Otherwise if any remaining upper bound <= threshold: report_reduction / upper_bound_below_threshold.
Otherwise if all measured values and all remaining lower bounds > threshold: report_no_reduction.
Otherwise: measure_next. Full grid exhausted: exact observed full-series call.

policies.frozen_action: Original priority tuple (interval contains threshold inclusive, minimum absolute log10 distance to measured doses, concentration); Python exact max. Initial chosen point must equal sealed choices.csv.
policies.uniform_random: Uniform over remaining candidates at EACH continuing step. Enumerate all stopped-prefix branches with exact Fraction probabilities. No Monte Carlo. Shared states can cache frozen predictions.
policies.log_maximin: Maximize minimum absolute log10 distance to measured concentrations. Exact ties use larger concentration, matching original action tie rule.
policies.highest_unmeasured: Additional literal-highest diagnostic: largest remaining concentration every step; distinguish initial highest-dose requests from original adaptive priority.

comparison_design: Change acquisition policy only. Preserve model, q, threshold, starting context and stopping rule. Evaluate all three original prediction methods; primary selected.
step_semantics: step0 is initial three-point state; step k is after k additional observations, including terminal state. Record revealed point, next requested point, predictions/intervals, observed IDs, call and reason. Random prefix rows have exact reach probability; terminal probabilities sum to one per curve.
truth: Any full-reference digitized response <= frozen threshold; full grid of positive published concentrations only.
cost_unit: One endpoint-specific concentration response (published aggregate mean); 12 curves, 36 initial and 46 hidden values, 82 total. Early means stopping strictly before that curve full grid. No physical chip/well/replicate cost inference or cross-endpoint sharing.
zero_width_counterfactual: Use original selected three-point predictions with q=0; evaluate same rule and truth. Prior known: 12 no-reduction calls, 5 correct, 7 wrong. Keep separately from actual replay.
evidence_status: The original next-dose requests were sealed before reveal at original manifest time. This protocol, all reconditioned predictions and subsequent sequential decisions are post-reveal retrospective replay. An observed reduction directly satisfies reference definition. Original 90% calibration was for k=3; reused q at k>=4 supplies no new sequential coverage guarantee.

resource_limits.end_condition: all 12 curves x three methods x five specified policies exhaust terminal branches; independent verification completes

verification: Separate implementation loads pinned inputs and models, independently computes frozen inference and decisions; enumerate all complete permutations for random, stop them, then compare exact expected cost/probability and all logged states.
